errorSignature: Hardcoded Supabase URL and keys in createBearerSupabaseClient
rootCause: Live service_role JWTs and staging Supabase URLs were hardcoded in repository files and env examples, bypassing secret injection.
resolution: Purged live tokens from all .env.example files. Refactored server.ts to enforce strictly using process.env and failing fast if undefined.
preventionRule: Never commit live credentials, API keys, or JWTs. Always use environment variables and ensure client factories validate their existence.
